verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs list ARM CPU support and an Apple Silicon hardware plugin among supported backends. That is the product's own documented hardware path, but it is only a single listing line, and the plugin's depth is unproven. Nothing in the pack mentions Metal-specific optimizations, acceleration, or real-world Mac performance. Missing for 10: explicit Metal/GPU acceleration documentation, detail on how mature the Apple Silicon plugin is, performance benchmarks on Apple Silicon, independent or hands-on corroboration.
